</parameter>

</tool_call><|im_end|>

<parameter=destination>

</parameter>
<parameter=depart_window>

</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

</parameter>
<parameter=day>
tomorrow
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>

</tool_response>
